text: The Stone of the Wilds is created by applying a Wildswater to a Stone of Fire.

The Stone Legion are a group of stoneborn who were loyal to Sire Denathrius. After the events of the rebellion, the return of the nathrezim to Revendreth, and the Stonewright's allegiance to Renathal, all the stoneborn (including Draven's Darkwing) are operating as the Stone Legion once more. Their duties are to defend Revendreth, enforce order in each Ward, and keep the devourers from coming out of the Endmire. They used to defend Revendreth from the Light attack on Ember Ward.

Stoneskin Totem is a totem that increases the Armor of all party and raid members within 40 yards.

Stoneclaw Totem is a totem. Shamans can drop it to take aggro from nearby mobs and occasionally stun them. It also protects all other totems by placing a protective shield on them. Combined with Glyph of Stoneclaw Totem, this totem plays an important role in PvP. The totem is sometimes affectionately referred to as the "Angry Stick".

The Stonemaul clan (or the Stonemaul Ogres) is an ogre clan which was allied with the orcs and, after the Second War, separated in two — one part sailing west to Kalimdor and establishing a village in Dustwallow Marsh while the other remained in Lordaeron.

as seen over Stonebull Lake at night.]] __NOTOC__ Stonebull Lake is a long horseshoe-shaped lake that surrounds Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore on three sides. It is known for its abundant fish, and many an hour is spent casting lines into the cool water. A bridge spans the lake at its narrowest point. The road that crosses this bridge connects Thunder Bluff to Bloodhoof Village.
__NOTOC__ Stonescale Oil is an alchemy component squeezed from Stonescale Eels... tasty!

Stonespine is an elite rare mob gargoyle that occasionally spawns as a replacement to the Rockwing Gargoyles or Rockwing Screechers in Stratholme. This means Stonespine is patrolling the area that those gargoyles would be patrolling, as all gargoyles found in Stratholme are patrolling the same area. The clearest threat is the danger that Stonespine might aggro while already in combat with other mobs. Stonespine's main source of damage is stacking a bleed, which deals substantially more damage as it stacks. Stonespine can usually be identified as a larger and more gray-colored gargoyle when compared to the other gargoyles.

__NOTOC__ Stonescale Eel is obtained by fishing and is a component in Stonescale Oil (made with Alchemy). The eels and their alchemic products are used in high-level potions used by raiders, Craftsman's Writ quests for Argent Dawn reputation, and a Tier 0.5 armor set quest. As a result, stonescale eel is one of the most lucrative fish one can catch.

The Stonefield Farm is one of two rival farmsteads in southern Elwynn Forest. The Stonefield family is in a bitter rivalry with the nearby Maclure family. Despite their intense dislike of each other, a child from each family has fallen in love with one another in true "Romeo and Juliet" fashion. There is hope their love can bring the two families together and, to that end, there are several quests that involve the feuding families.
__NOTOC__ Stonetusk Boars are boars found at the Stonefield Farm, at the Maclure Vineyards, and in the area just south of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

Stoneskin Gargoyle Cape is a Level 48 quality cloak. It gives bonuses to Agility, Stamina and Haste.
Stoneslayer is a two-handed sword which has a chance on hit to increase damage by 10 for 8 seconds. It is a sword that strikes as hard as you would expect for a creation of the titans.

The Stonegullet ogres are a group of ogres found in the Searing Gorge. A group of them barricaded the road leading south to Blackrock Spire, and demand tribute from all wishing to pass, and with the help of three black drakes to ensure that all travelers paid the toll.

Stonehearth Bunker is the alliance’s southernmost bunker in Alterac Valley, located south east of Stormpike Graveyard, almost in line with Stonehearth Outpost. It is one of the closest (and most vulnerable) alliance targets for the horde when the battle starts – although it is sometimes skipped to be captured after Stonehearth Outpost and Stonehearth Graveyard. Like Icewing Bunker, it is protected by 4 Stormpike Bowmen. There are no archers on the ground floor, all are located at the top of the bunker. The archers can often be taken out from outside the bunker by ranged horde players (hunters, priests, warlocks) - something not always possible for the horde towers due to the fact that horde

Stonehearth Outpost is the Stormpike Guard outpost that is located just north of the Field of Strife near Stonehearth Graveyard. It is home to the alliance captain Balinda Stonehearth. Her horde equivalent is Captain Galvangar in Iceblood Garrison. Throughout the course of the battle, she can urge the alliance with battle cries, giving them a temporary 20% health buff. Killing her will result in honor for the horde forces, Frostwolf Clan faction gain, stops the spawning of some alliance NPCs and prevents alliance players from receiving their buff. Stonebreaker Camp is a small Horde camp in eastern Terokkar Forest. It is closeby to the fortified town of Stonebreaker Hold. Sergeant Chawni and Shadowstalker Kaide can be found residing here at this camp. They are investigating the activities of Firewing Point.

Stonevault Cave Hunters are troggs found in the Badlands and the non-instanced area of Uldaman. They are mostly found in the North Common Hall and South Common Hall areas. They are members of the Stonevault group, found all over the ancient ruins. The troggs have been disturbed by the dwarves' explosives, used while mining. They now prevent any further exploration of the halls. These particular troggs have stolen the miners' equipment and use it to fight.

The Stonesplinter tribe is a tribe of pink-skinned troggs found residing at Ironband's Excavation Site, cave south of Thelsamar, and Stonesplinter Valley in Loch Modan. They have later become members of the Axis of Awful, though most likely through some form of coercion or trickery by the Tunnel Rat kobolds.

Stonespine Gargoyles are gargoyles found in the Pit of Saron in and around the pit itself. The gargoyles do not start out attackable. They must first drag-and-drop slaves of the opposite faction before they can be attacked or aggroed.
Stonevault Cave Lurkers are troggs found in Dig Two and Map Chamber in Uldaman.

The Stonecore is a dungeon located in Deepholm, introduced in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm. The entrance is at on the west side of the Temple of Earth, 2/3 to the top. Queuing for Stonecore through the Dungeon Finder requires an average item level of 272 and to discover the entrance.
The Stonegouge Headgear is a quest reward from Mystery Solved which begins with Cenarion Researcher Korrah in Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

Stonemaul Hold is a fortified ogre mound outpost located southwest of Dire Maul in Feralas. The outpost is led by Orhan Ogreblade, leader of the Stonemaul clan in the area. It's from here Orhan uses the ogres to help bring down the Gordunni ogres down, so that the Horde cause use the resources that those ogres waste.

Stonehearth is the home of the Earthen within Deepholm. The town is located on the upper shelf in the far southwest. The town has been overtaken by the stone troggs, the earthen fight to retake it, and then move onto the stone troggs home for revenge. Stormcaller Mylra came here and asked the earthen about Thrall's weapon, the Doomhammer. They didn't know anything about the weapon, but they were missing several prospectors. The prospectors were found dead in the Crumbling Depths by the Earthen Ring.
Stonefather Oremantle is an elite earthen located throughout Deepholm. He is the leader of all earthen within Deepholm.
Stonescale Drakes are stone drakes located at the Alabaster Shelf of Deepholm.

Stonetalon Prisoners are orcs located at Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens. They surrendered to the Alliance and are armed with Confiscated Arms to regain their honor for the quest Warriors' Redemption.
Stonehoof Geology is a shop found on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff. The place is run by Brek and Kurm of the Stonehoof tribe.
The Stonescythe flayers are a pack of rock flayers settled within the Great Fissure of southern Hellfire Peninsula. This pack have found the Broken an easy prey.
Stonefather's Banner is a banner received for Stonefather's Boon. As the number of the stone troggs increased in number, this banner gives the Stonehearth defenders an increased damage dealt.
Stonebreaker's Report is a quest item for Demanding Answers.
Stonemaul Ogres are ogre guards located in Stonemaul Hold in Feralas.
Stonebreaker's Gauntlets is a quest reward from Grimaxe's Demise.
The Stonescale Robes are a quest reward from Resonating Blow.
The Stonespeaker's Belt is a quest reward from Sins of the Sea Witch.

The Stonespire tribe is a tribe of tauren that lived in the southern Barrens. After begin driven out of their ancestral home with many killed, now the survivors are seemingly scattered across Kalimdor, with Gann Stonespire calling them a lost tribe and a "memory."
Stonemaul Slinger is a quest reward from Might of the Stonemaul.

Stoneplow is a small farming village found just east of the wall separating the Valley of the Four Winds from the Dread Wastes to the west. The Blacksoil, Greentill, Marlfur, and Spadepaw families of farmers tend to its fields. Stoneplow has come under attack from the mantid, and the Shado-Pan have come to help fend off the invasion. Had the mantid taken the village, they would be able to take the entire valley as there is nothing beyond this point that could stop them. The village sent Han and Len in search of help.

The Stonefields are a human family located in Elwynn Forest. They own the Stonefield Farm. Until at least Cataclysm, they were embroiled in a family feud with the Maclures. In Warlords of Draenor, they can move out to to man the Barn erected in an Alliance adventurer's garrison at Lunarfall.
Stonecarver Mac is a pandaren resident of Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Stonecutter Lon is a pandaren found at Greenstone Village of Jade Forest, but only during the scenario.
Stoneripper Magnaron is a magnaron located at the Forge Gates in Frostfire Ridge.

Stonefang Outpost is a Frostwolf Orcs outpost in central Frostfire Ridge. Bordered by the Boneslag to the north, the Icewind Drifts to the east, and the Stonefang Ridge to the south, the outpost is beset by Thunderlord invaders during the attack on Wor'gol. Lokra is sent to help secure the situation.
Stonetooth is a goren located in Frostwall and Lunarfall mines.
Stonehide Riverbeasts are riverbeasts found at the Road of Glory in Ashran. They are found in the water near the center of the zone.
Stonespite is a basilisk located in Apexis Excavation in the Spires of Arak.
__NOTOC__ Stonescale is a raptor found in Spires of Arak. Several Ravenspeaker Statues can be found nearby.

Stonegrinder is found at in Ketya's Stash, found in the back of a well-guarded Ketya's Hideaway on the Orunai Coast of northeastern Talador.

The Stones of Prophecy are a natural formation located just south of the in (at the same location where Garadar is located in Outland). During his incursion into the alternate , Garrosh Hellscream showed the past incarnation of his father, , why he must reject 's "gift". Upon being confronted by Thrall at Grommashar, Garrosh accepts Thrall's challenge of mak'gora and elects to fight it at the Stones, "where it all began" (likely referencing both where Thrall first met Garrosh at Garadar, and where Garrosh convinced Grommash to form the Iron Horde), where he is defeated by Thrall's mastery of the elements.
Stonefang Ridge is located just south of Stonefang Outpost overlooking the Burning Glacier in Frostfire Ridge.

The Stoneraker brothers were aided by Li Li Stormstout when they were attacked by the virmen. After seeing she expected a reward, each of the brother offered her a kiss. An unimpressed Li Li was implied to have hit them for this and then continued on her journey to Zouchin Village. While going about their business the pair were met by Chen Stormstout and Yalia Sagewhisper and soon after became employees of the Stormstout Brewery.

Stonecrag Gorge is a large gorge in central . The goblins of Steamwheedle Preservation Society have recently started digging at the site not far from where the of ogres have been digging. The ogres on the north side of the gorge have revealed a cavern known as the Vault of the Titan.
Stonemaul Succession Stone is a common ogre archaeology artifact, created from 40 Ogre Archaeology Fragments. One Ogre Missive may be used to solve this artifact.

The Stonefury Cliffs are located in the northern part of Frostfire Ridge. They face the Colossal Depths sea. They are the home of the of ogre. The Bloodmaul Slag Mines, the Bloodmaul Stronghold and a number of other related locations are found here. The area is heavily populated by both ogre and ogron of the Bloodmaul clan, as well as their slaves.

Stonescar Gorge is a water filled gorge found in Stormheim. Basilisks have overtaken the area turning anyone here to statue.

Stoneskin Gatekeepers are gargoyles found in Icecrown Citadel during The Call of Icecrown. Two of them are guarding the gate leading to the Spire and need to be damaged until they turn to stone, at which point at least one of them must then be moved onto one of the pressure plates using Death Grip while the death knight themselves stand on the other plate in order to open the gate.

Stonemaul Magi is a variant of the normal ogre magi belonging to the Stonemaul Clan that appeared in the Founding of Durotar campaign. After Rexxar killed Kor'gall and was appointed leader of the clan, the Stonemaul ogres joined the Horde to fight against the soldiers of Daelin Proudmoore.
